messages:
Tess: Quick sync on PaperTrail case study. Interview locked for Fri 9am PT. Need owners for quote pre-clear, a 30s social clip + redacted transcript, hero stat for the blog, and webinar registrant routing. Can we assign owners?

Rory: Ill take the long-form copy and the hero image. Claudia can you take quote pre-clear? Diego, can you do the clip and transcript redaction? Marta, can you handle SFDC campaign and zap routing?

Claudia (Legal): Happy to review quotes. Please send exact proposed lines and attach signed release. Legal needs the benchmark CSV or a methodology note if youre using precise numbers.

Diego: Ill produce the 30s cut and redact anything that mentions internal model IDs. Drop the raw file link and rough timestamps and Ill slice it.

Tess: Raw: https://files.redwood/papertrail/interview_may03.mp4. Highlight around 00:05:40-00:06:05 when they talk about throughput. Redact model names and internal bucket IDs; keep high-level product terms and numbers.

Rory: Draft quote candidate: "Switching to Redwood reduced our inference costs by 38% and improved p95 latency to under 0.7s"  CTO, PaperTrail

Claudia (Legal): Suggest conservative tweak until benchmarks are attached: "we observed ~38% lower inference cost and substantially improved p95 latency". I can pre-clear that now. Also tagging release-bot for checklist.

release-bot: Automated check: missing file `papertrail_release_signed.pdf`. Upload required before legal approval is complete.

Hannah: Im running the benchmark now (job `pt-bench-2026A`). Expect CSV + small methodology note in ~90 minutes. Will include batch sizes and p95 calculation details.

Claudia (Legal): If Hannah uploads CSV and methodology I can approve the exact numbers and the stronger quote. Otherwise we use conservative language.

Diego: Got the raw. Will output 30s social cut + 60s linkedin cut. Will upload redacted transcript and timecodes here when done.

Marta (Sales Ops): For routing: creating SFDC campaign = PT_CASE_JUN2026, AE queue = growth-midmarket. Will tag leads with utm_campaign=papertrail_case and add `bench_downloaded` if they grab the benchmark PDF within 48 hours. Ill post the Zap config in #sales-ops.

Tess: Timeline: webinar Wednesday 10am PT, publish case + benchmark blog same afternoon, social cuts live during webinar. Legal signed release required in thread before publish.

Hannah: Uploaded `pt-bench-2026A-results.csv` to `benchmarks/papertrail/`. Method: synthetic traffic 2k requests, batch 8, measured p95 across run. Results: cost down 38.3%, p95 0.66s down from 1.85s.

Claudia (Legal): Received. Approving the precise numbers and Rorys stronger quote now that artifacts are attached. Please attach `papertrail_release_signed.pdf` and logo permission file before publish.

Rory: Thanks. Ill slot the exact hero stat (38% and 0.66s p95) into the draft and circulate for a final read.

Diego: Uploading clips + redacted transcript now. Will drop URLs in thread when ready.

Marta (Sales Ops): Zap pushed live and test registration synced to SFDC campaign. Campaign ID = 7039B2. Will add `bench_downloaded` tag rule as requested.

Tess: Great work. Recap: Rory copy + publish, Claudia legal sign-off (pending release), Diego clip+redaction, Hannah benchmarks uploaded, Marta SFDC + routing. Once signed release is attached were green to publish post-webinar.

Rory: Ill ping when the draft is ready for final review.

Claudia (Legal): Once the release PDF is attached here Ill mark legal checklist complete.

Tess: Closing loop for now  will reopen when assets + release are in. :sparkles:
